messages:
Maya R.: Hey all — quick proposal: can we try shifting the weekly engineering triage/owners sync 30m earlier and shorten it to 25m? Attendance has dropped and I think a tighter agenda + fixed owner roll would help.
Raj P.: +1 to shorter. 25m seems tight but doable if we trim the active bug walk.
Olivia K.: Is 30m earlier 9:00 -> 8:30 PT? I have an onboarding at 9:10 most weeks. 8:30 works for me but prefer 8:40 if we can.
Tim H.: I can't do earlier than 8:45 regularly. Also support the owner-rotate idea but we should make the rotation explicit (who owns each slot).
Maya R.: Good call — propose we: 1) move to 8:45 PT start, 2) make it 25m, 3) fixed agenda: 5m quick status, 10m bug queue triage, 7m owner action items, 3m followups. Thoughts?
Raj P.: Sounds reasonable. For bug queue, can we pre-filter critical/high only? saves time.
Olivia K.: Pre-filter critical/high yes. Also suggest a tiny canary slot — one minute for any urgent unblock that can't wait.
Tim H.: On owner rotation: propose weekly owner changes, list published in a shared doc and a rotating calendar invite owner. Whoever is owner posts the short summary in #eng before the call.
Eli S.: I can automate the owner pings via a tiny script if we maintain an owners list. It can DM the owner 30m before and post a reminder in the thread.
Maya R.: Eli — that would be awesome. Can you prototype? If yes, add a checkbox to the agenda template for "owner pre-check".
Eli S.: Yep will do. Will post a draft script and usage in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
Raj P.: One more thing: can we alternate an RFC/design quick-spotlight every 3rd meeting (5m) instead of the canary slot sometimes? keeps reviews visible.
Olivia K.: Love the spotlight idea. Maybe swap spotlight <-> canary every other week so urgent things still get a chance.
Tim H.: Agree. Also request: put a pinned checklist in the calendar invite with the 4-item agenda so people come prepared.
DeployBot: Calendar event updated: "Eng owners sync" moved to 2026-04-06 08:45 PT, duration 25m. Attendees: engineering@redwood.com.
Maya R.: Thanks deploy-bot. Final action items: Eli to prototype owner-ping, Tim to draft rotation list, Raj to put pre-filter rules for bug queue, Olivia to coordinate spotlight schedule. We'll reconvene on this thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
